text: Testing plays an important role in software development. Unit tests check small parts of the code, such as individual functions, to make sure they work correctly. Integration tests go further and check how different parts of the system work together. Many developers use test-driven development, which means writing tests before writing the actual code. This approach helps them plan better and avoid mistakes. Testing gives developers confidence. When tests pass, they know their changes have not broken anything. This confidence allows teams to improve the software faster and with less fear. In short, good testing saves time and leads to better quality products.
